briefings.title: Suleika Jaouad: Harnessing Creativity and Curiosity to Lead Through Uncertainty

people.name: Suleika Jaouad
people.role: Author and Creator, The Isolation Journals

briefings.tldr: Journaling is a vital "democratic" creative tool that allows leaders to navigate uncertainty by prioritizing internal reflection over external productivity, ultimately "alchemizing" life's challenges into meaningful insights and deeper human connections.
